How good are these chances?

We replayed 62 past invite lists from 2025 and 2026, hiding every result from 1 to 8 weeks before each cutoff, and checked the chances shown then against the teams actually invited.

Chance shownTeamsAverage shownActually invited
0–20%7,8234%
5%
20–40%1,75730%
31%
40–60%1,33949%
47%

On the 17 lists where few teams turned their invite down, 87% of the teams holding the top spots a week before the cutoff were invited; eight weeks out, 80%. Chances under 80% have come in within two points; those above 80% a few points low.

Backtest of October 25th, 2026.

Valve ranking of Counter-Strike Teams

Ranking follows Valve's model for ranking Counter-Strike teams.

How is the ranking calculated?

The ranking takes into account the accomplishments of teams starting from the chosen date (in Copenhagen timezone), inclusive of that day and extending back over the previous six months.
